name: Amoré
description: A balanced warm rose that heals true on melanin-rich lips. Built for natural lip blush and full lip procedures where softness matters.
ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Propylene Glycol, CI colorants. Sterilized gamma ray. Nano pigment formulation.
usage: Shake well before use. For permanent makeup procedures by trained professionals only.
cautions: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Keep out of reach of children.
